name: fake-messenger
description: App de mensajeria para partidas de rol: DM, jugadores y voyeristas

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:compose
